question: Which dancer founded the Kalakshetra Institute in Chennai that promotes performing art forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukmini Devi Arundale**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was a renowned Indian classical dancer and the founder of the **Kalakshetra Foundation**, an academy for Bharatanatyam and other Indian art forms.
 
• She was instrumental in reviving and re-establishing Bharatanatyam as a respected and sophisticated classical dance form in the 20th century.
 
• The **Kalakshetra Foundation**, established in 1936 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, continues to promote Indian performing arts and cultural traditions globally.
 
• She is widely credited with introducing innovative techniques in stagecraft and costumes to enhance the visual appeal of Bharatanatyam.
 
• Rukmini Devi also worked towards preserving Indian heritage and was a strong advocate of cultural education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam:**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It combines expressions (bhava), melody (raga), rhythm (tala), and dramatic performance (natya).
 
• This dance form was traditionally performed in temples as an offering to deities.
 
 
 
• **Kalakshetra Foundation:**
 
 
• Kalakshetra means "a holy place of arts" and focuses on Bharatanatyam, Carnatic music, and visual arts.
 
• The foundation is recognized as an institution of national importance under the Indian Constitution.
 
• It follows a Gurukula system of education, emphasizing discipline and holistic learning.
 
 
 
• **Rukmini Devi's Contributions:**
 
 
• She redefined Bharatanatyam by removing its association with Devadasi culture and aligning it with modern aesthetics.
 
• She introduced mythological themes and used Sanskrit compositions in performances.
 
• Her efforts ensured the survival and global recognition of Bharatanatyam.
 
 
 
• **Honors and Recognition:**
 
 
• Rukmini Devi was nominated to the Rajya Sabha in 1952 for her contributions to Indian culture.
 
• She received the Padma Bhushan in 1956 and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship in 1967.
